text:
Priya: Quick sync — we need a governance roadmap for the Snowflake + Databricks connector bundle, plus vector DB adapters and NVIDIA perf validation. High level: certification checklist, marketplace listing requirements, SI enablement playbook, and joint-announcement timing. Who can take point?
Jorge: I can grab certification checklist and marketplace metadata. Need to know the exact SKU names for listings.
Elena: I'll own SI enablement playbook (training + sample infra). Can we get a sample customer for a pilot?
Tom: I can do the announcement timeline and coordinate comms. Suggest aiming for a soft launch two weeks after cert signoff. :calendar:
Nate: On NVIDIA side — we'll run quantized inference perf tests. Need model/sequence-length targets and expected QPS. Who supplies test harness?
Priya: @Nate we'll use the internal perf harness (eng-runtime) but need the connectors to expose batch endpoints. @Jorge can you add that to the checklist?
Jorge: Yep — adding: 1) Marketplace metadata (title, logo, sku), 2) Connector health endpoints & batching support, 3) Terraform snippet for infra, 4) integration tests with Snowflake external functions and Databricks jobs.
MarketplaceBot: Draft listing created: https://marketplace.redwood.example/drafts/connector-2026 (visibility: private)
Elena: For SI playbook: include step-by-step onboarding, common troubleshooting, network/VPC diagrams, and sample deployment templates for AWS/Azure. Also a slide deck for partner trainings.
Tom: Announcement plan draft: internal comms -> partner beta -> marketplace listing -> public blog. Two-week beta window to collect metrics. Need hook up with growth for early access.
Priya: Risks: data egress requirements for regulated customers, KMS/HSM expectations for Private deployments, and perf regressions on older GPUs. Add mitigation items.
Nate: For perf tests: I'll run tests on A10 + H100 nodes. Please post expected payload distribution (seq len / prompt churn). A snippet works, e.g., `{"seq_len_dist": [20,64,256], "qps_target": 200}`
Jorge: Added a section for required artifacts: connector.yaml manifest, terraform example, e2e smoke test, performance report PDF, and marketplace screenshots.
Elena: Can we also include vector DB compatibility matrix (Pinecone, Milvus, Qdrant)? shorthand notes on index format and latency expectations.
Tom: Action items: Jorge (marketplace checklist + manifest) / Elena (SI playbook + matrix) / Nate (perf runs + report) / Tom (comm plan) / Priya (overall coordinator). Deadline: EOD next Thu (1719803460).
Priya: Perfect. I'll create a shared folder and a short tracking spreadsheet. Ping me for blockers. :thumbsup:
